# ISSUE_TEMPLATE Directory – AI Moral Code

This folder contains all YAML-based GitHub Issue Templates used in the `aimoralcode` repository.

## Purpose

GitHub automatically reads from `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` to generate issue forms accessible via:
```
https://github.com/rjhinrichs/aimoralcode/issues/new
```

These templates streamline structured input from users, contributors, and collaborators.

## Current Templates

- `new-blogpost.yml` – Submits a new blog post to the `_posts/` directory via GitHub Actions.
- `blog-contributor-request.yml` – Formal request to become a regular blog contributor.
- `bug-report.yml` – Flags bugs or errors in content, logic, or rendering.
- `feature-request.yml` – Suggests new features for site structure, taxonomy, or tooling.
- `general-inquiry.yml` – For general questions or philosophical input.

## Notes

- **Do not rename this folder.** GitHub recognizes only `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` for structured issue templates.
- The `config.yml` file in this directory manages category groupings for the GitHub interface.
